## Overview

Python bindings for the IFC facade (ADR 0013, #39).

The compiled module is `openbim_ifc._native`; the public API is the pure
Python package `openbim_ifc`, which wraps it and defines the value
classes. Values cross as plain dicts in the tagged encoding shared with
the WASM and C bindings; `openbim_ifc` turns them into frozen dataclasses.

This crate adds calling-convention glue only. IFC behaviour belongs in
`openbim-ifc`, shared binding behaviour in `openbim-ifc-binding-core`.

## Changes

Latest release, 0.12.1 (2026-10-18):

### Changed (#506, #509)

- `product_curves` returns polylines for trimmed, composite, offset and intrinsic
  curves (an `IfcTrimmedCurve` axis, an `IfcCompositeCurve` footprint, an
  IFC4X3 clothoid), which were `unsupported` refusals. A curve the
  reference compiler has no certified polyline for (an implicit curve, an
  offset of an offset) is still `unsupported`, its refusal now naming the
  product rather than the curve. Advanced B-reps whose edges cover part of
  their line, circle or ellipse mesh (#509). No API change.

Semver: patch.
